remarks: 11 Bellaire Drive in Westport, CT is a warm and welcoming flexible term, furnished rental home, ready to move into on a quiet and convenient Westport cul-de-sac. Whether you are in transition, testing the suburbs, renovating a house or just haven't found the right home to buy yet, this is your opportunity to enjoy convenience and comfort with access to all Westport has to offer. A commuter's dream, this 4 bedroom home has a great yard, updated kitchen, plenty of space without feeling cavernous, and an open floor plan. Landlord somewhat flexible on fully or partially furnished.
